item.title: 2026 Geely Coolray Review | Still Here. Still Good?
item.description: The Geely Coolray is one of the first cars that gained a ton of popularity back when Chinese vehicles were not as accepted as they are now. As one of the pioneers in the industry, Geely has stuck by the Coolray all these years, iterating and improving on its formula. It still has a quality interior, an engine that pulls hard, and Geely's signature style. However, in a market where electrification is running rampant, does the Coolray still have what it takes to offer value for its price? Find out
